items.title: Speed Insights and Web Analytics now support custom environments
items.summary: and  now fully support .Speed InsightsWeb Analyticscustom environmentsPreviously, data captured on deployments to a custom environment was attributed to the Preview environment. That data is now attributed to the custom environment it came from, so you can track performance and traffic for staging, QA, or canary environments separately from Production and Preview.You can view this data in several places:This change only affects how data is attributed. No new data points are collected, and no configuration changes are needed.Custom environments are available on Pro and Enterprise plans. Learn more in the .environments documentationRead more use the Environment dropdown in Speed Insights and Web Analytics to pick a custom environmentDashboard: query it with the  commandCLI:vc metrics filter and break down by environmentQuery builder: query it programmatically (Web Analytics only)Aggregation API:
